Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) are helpful and consistently yield statistically significant gains.

lessons: Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, producing significant gains in two tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), though one test showed no clear effect.

Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), tutorials (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured).
